
```{r config, eval = T}
input_dir <- params$input_dir
# input_dir <- ".."
input_dir <- normalizePath(input_dir)
if(! is_hiseq_dir(input_dir, "_rn")) {
  stop(paste0("Input file is not alignment_rn directory: ", input_dir))
}
```


```{r}
# all hiseq dirs
read_hiseq_align2 <- function(x, raw = FALSE) {
  b <- list.dirs(x, recursive = FALSE)
  b <- purrr::keep(b, function(i) is_hiseq_dir(i) & ! is_hiseq_dir(i, "alignment_"))
  df1 <- lapply(b, read_hiseq_align) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(index)
  # fix unique/map
  unique_only <- list_hiseq_file(input_dir, "unique_only")
  map_col <- ifelse(unique_only, "unique", "map")
  df2 <- df1 %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("name", "index", map_col)))
  names(df2) <- c("name", "index", "count")
  # fix total, unmap
  df3 <- data.frame(
    name = df1[["name"]][1],
    index = c("total", "unmap"),
    count = c(dplyr::pull(df1, "total")[1], # first
              rev(dplyr::pull(df1, "unmap"))[1])
  )
  # combine
  df4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(df2, df3)
  # output
  if(isTRUE(raw)) {
    df1
  } else {
    df4
  }
}

df1 <- read_hiseq_align2(input_dir, raw = TRUE)
df4 <- read_hiseq_align2(input_dir, raw = FALSE)
```

```{r}
n_smp <- 1 # rn
n_index <- nrow(df1)
total <- max(dplyr::pull(df1, "total"))
unmap <- min(dplyr::pull(df1, "unmap"))
map   <- total - unmap
# map   <- dplyr::pull(df1, all_of(map_col)) %>% sum()
map_pct  <- round(map / total * 100, 2)
total    <- round(total / 1e6, 2)
map      <- round(map / 1e6, 2)
```

```{r loading data, eval = F}
pd <- read_hiseq(input_dir)
df_align <- read_hiseq_align(input_dir)

# summary
n_smp    <- nrow(df_align)
total    <- df_align %>% pull(total) %>% mean() %>% round(digits = 1)
map      <- df_align %>% pull(map) %>% mean() %>% round(digits = 1)
map_pct  <- round(map / total * 100, 2)
total    <- round(total / 1e6, 2)
map      <- round(map / 1e6, 2)
```


## 1 Summary

```{r summary, results="asis"}
sum_text <- glue::glue(
  "A total of {n_smp} samples, to {n_index} indexes; {total}M sequencing depth ",
  "with {map}M ({map_pct}%) reads mapped to index; "
)
print(sum_text)
```
